newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open mostly unchanged.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open little changed on Friday, based on market orders at 1020 EDT, trading sources said.
Prices should remain steady ahead of the U.S. Department of Agriculture's final planted area estimate, released Monday at 0830 EDT.
Analysts put the estimate at 13.83-14.30 million acres. The market has absorbed a reduction to about 14.0 million acres, and a lower number could spark gains, they said.
Thursday, the benchmark contract closed 0.28 cent lower at 77.16 cents per lb, having ranged from 77.25 to 76.95 cents. The rest of the board settled 0.35 to 0.10 cent weaker.
An estimated 18,000 lots changed hands on the day.
NYCE said 135 notices were issued today, bringing the total number of notices to date, to 686 notices.
